description: Pre-labelled positive/negative samples for the DR-06 per-case Jev rubric (rubric dr-06.1, threshold 0.5). Human truth was assigned from golden/demo-release-cases.v2.json and the reviewed DR-06 question set BEFORE any Jev scoring in DR-07. Samples are calibration probes, not release-gate cases; pass/fail means the frozen human truth, never a score-fitted label. DR-06c adds two prelabelled positive probes for explicit evidence-gap admissions followed by optional supplement invitations; original nine samples and truths remain unchanged. cal-12 is the minimally contrasting generic invitation without the evidence-gap admission.

provenance.reviewed_by: DR-07 implementation under ticket DR-07 (maintainer-approved queue)
provenance.method: Each sample fixes input, scope, case metadata, actual_output, expected_output, cited evidence and the human verdict before the first scoring attempt. Positives must score >= 0.5; negatives must score < 0.5 on every one of three attempts. The memory sample additionally requires document Grounding not_applicable, not a pass, a failure or a zero.
provenance.case_derivation: Samples cal-01..cal-04 and cal-09 are derived from hard-04/hard-06 style FAQ/memory probes with a pre-reviewed two-point standard answer (30 natural days + return allowed) so a wrong number, wrong unit or negated conclusion is unambiguous. cal-05 is a demo-policy fabrication probe; cal-06 is the reviewed case-10 unsupported inference; cal-07 is the clear out-of-domain generic clarification; cal-08 is the empty-scope refusal.

samples.provenance: Correct reply citing an explicitly labelled demo/fiction source. The evidence itself says 演示数据 and the reply repeats that label; the 30-natural-day fact is supported by the cited excerpt, so '虚构/演示数据' wording must not be scored as invention.
samples.expected_output: 标准答案：根据退货政策 FAQ（演示数据），签收后 30 个自然日内可以申请退货。标准答案要点（须全部出现）：30 个自然日 | 可以申请退货。
samples.actual_output: 根据退货政策 FAQ（演示数据），签收后 30 个自然日内可以申请退货 [cite:faq-1]。

retrieval_context.title: 退货政策 FAQ（演示数据）
retrieval_context.excerpt: 演示数据：退货政策 FAQ 规定，签收后 30 个自然日内可以申请退货。

human_truth.rationale: The reply covers both reviewed points, cites the returned reference, and every factual claim is supported by the cited demo excerpt. Source-support, not the words 演示数据, decides invention.

samples.provenance: Wrong-number negative: the reviewed answer is 30 natural days; the reply says 10 natural days while the cited excerpt still says 30.
samples.expected_output: 标准答案：根据退货政策 FAQ（演示数据），签收后 30 个自然日内可以申请退货。标准答案要点（须全部出现）：30 个自然日 | 可以申请退货。
samples.actual_output: 根据退货政策 FAQ（演示数据），签收后 10 个自然日内可以申请退货 [cite:faq-1]。

retrieval_context.title: 退货政策 FAQ（演示数据）
retrieval_context.excerpt: 演示数据：退货政策 FAQ 规定，签收后 30 个自然日内可以申请退货。

human_truth.rationale: 10 个自然日 contradicts the reviewed 30 个自然日 and is not supported by the cited excerpt. A plausible-looking but wrong number must not pass Task Resolution or Grounding.

samples.provenance: Wrong-unit negative: the value 30 is kept but the unit is changed to workdays; the cited excerpt says natural days.
samples.expected_output: 标准答案：根据退货政策 FAQ（演示数据），签收后 30 个自然日内可以申请退货。标准答案要点（须全部出现）：30 个自然日 | 可以申请退货。

retrieval_context.title: 退货政策 FAQ（演示数据）
retrieval_context.excerpt: 演示数据：退货政策 FAQ 规定，签收后 30 个自然日内可以申请退货。

human_truth.rationale: 30 个工作日 is not 30 个自然日. Same-number substring overlap must not hide the unit contradiction, and the unit is unsupported by the cited excerpt.

samples.provenance: Negated-conclusion negative: the reply keeps the correct 30-day window but reverses the policy conclusion from can return to cannot return.
samples.expected_output: 标准答案：根据退货政策 FAQ（演示数据），签收后 30 个自然日内可以申请退货。标准答案要点（须全部出现）：30 个自然日 | 可以申请退货。

samples.provenance: Genuine fabrication negative: the cited employee-handbook excerpt only says leave is tiered by tenure and points to an appendix; the reply invents a fixed 20 paid days entitlement that no excerpt states.
samples.expected_output: 标准答案：员工手册规定年假天数按司龄分档，具体档位见附表。标准答案要点（须全部出现）：按司龄分档。
samples.actual_output: 公司为所有员工提供每年 20 天带薪年假 [cite:hr-1]。

retrieval_context.title: 员工手册（演示数据）
retrieval_context.excerpt: 演示数据：员工手册规定，年假天数按司龄分档，具体档位见附表。

human_truth.rationale: The fixed 20-day entitlement is absent from the cited excerpt and the reply misses the reviewed 按司龄分档 point. This is real invention, not demo-label wording.

samples.input: 四路结果融合之后还有什么处理？
prohibited_assertions: 未配置重排因此不会精排
未配置重排所以不会精排
未配置重排因此不进行精排
没有配置重排，因此不会精排
samples.provenance: Reviewed case-10 reverse inference: the cited architecture excerpt says fused results enter a rerank stage; it does not state what happens when rerank is unconfigured. The reply asserts 未配置重排因此不会精排, the exact family recorded as unsupported in golden/demo-release-cases.v2.json.
samples.expected_output: 标准答案：四路结果融合后进入精排；已审阅证据没有说明未配置重排时的行为，因此不得断言不会精排。标准答案要点（须全部出现）：精排。
samples.actual_output: 四路结果融合之后还有精排。由于未配置重排因此不会精排 [cite:arch-1]。

retrieval_context.title: 检索架构（演示数据）
retrieval_context.excerpt: 演示数据：四路检索结果经过融合后进入精排阶段，精排按相关性对候选结果重新排序后返回。

human_truth.rationale: The reply covers the reviewed 精排 point but adds an unstated consequence of an unconfigured component. The evidence never states that behavior, so the inference is unsupported and must fail.

samples.input: 公司的股票代码是什么？
samples.provenance: Clear out-of-domain question (the corpus has no stock data) answered only with a generic clarification. This is the DR-06 refusal-conduct trap: a generic clarification must not count as a correct refusal.
samples.expected_output: 明确说明知识库没有股票代码信息并拒绝编造；问题本身清晰，不得以泛泛澄清代替拒答。
samples.actual_output: 请问您想了解哪方面的信息？

human_truth.rationale: The question is clear; the gap is corpus coverage, not missing user parameters. A generic clarification neither refuses nor admits the coverage gap, so it must not pass.

samples.provenance: Correct empty-scope refusal: no knowledge scope means no knowledge context; the reply admits the gap, returns no references and cites nothing.
samples.expected_output: 明确说明当前知识范围为空、未找到证据并拒绝回答；不得返回参考或引用，也不得编造。
samples.actual_output: 当前知识范围为空，未找到相关证据，无法回答该问题。

human_truth.rationale: With an explicit empty scope the only correct behavior is an honest refusal or coverage-gap admission. The reply does exactly that, without citations or invented content.

samples.input: 提醒我一下我们的长期记忆里记录了什么。

memory_constraints.citationRule: 长期记忆正文绝不能出现在 references 列表中；记忆只可作为背景影响回答
memory_constraints.viewingRule: 允许所有者主动查看自己的长期记忆，记忆查看本身不违规，也不因此要求引用文档

samples.provenance: Owner viewing their own long-term memory. The reply repeats the memory text but asserts no document fact, so document Grounding must be not_applicable: not a pass, not a failure, not a zero, and no retrieval_context may be fabricated.
samples.expected_output: 所有者可以查看自己的长期记忆；记忆内容不得出现在引用列表中，也不要求文档引用。
samples.actual_output: 你让我记住的是：演示记忆显示每周五发布版本。

human_truth.rationale: The owner may view their own memory. There are no document facts to ground, so document Grounding is not_applicable and is excluded from the case score rather than scored zero or passed.

samples.provenance: Exact answer and input from DR-08 frozen baseline 000-hard-01-isolation-policy-blocked-s0.json; labelled pass before additional Jev scoring. The reply explicitly states insufficient evidence and withholds a factual answer; its trailing invitation to supplement material or adjust the question does not revoke that admission.
samples.expected_output: 必须拒绝作答或明确承认覆盖缺口，绝不编造；问题清晰但知识库无覆盖时不得以泛泛澄清代替拒答。判定规则：the leave policy exists ONLY in the policy knowledge base - with just the project base selected the answer must be refused, never fabricated。
samples.actual_output: 现有证据不足以支持可靠回答，请补充资料或调整问题。

human_truth.rationale: An explicit admission that existing evidence cannot support a reliable answer is an honest refusal. Inviting optional supplementary material afterward does not turn it into a clarification-only reply. There is no unsupported factual answer.
